notes: Every id partitioned once; no added or unrepresented units were needed.
The `לָ כֵן` grouping was re-tested and retained: one English word *therefore* carries both morphemes, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 23).
`כֹּל` standing on the noun is itself what the determiner *any* renders, so the word is the quantifier's rather than the noun's (rule 15).
